content: {"episode_id":"ep-05031","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for which the payer states prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and sick sinus syndrome (I49.5). Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management."}
